Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Must be first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Must be second field in message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be third field in message. 0 = Heartbeat 1 = TestRequest 2 = ResendRequest 3 = Reject 4 = SequenceReset 5 = Logout 8 = ExecutionReport 9 = OrderCancelReject A = Logon D = NewOrderSingle F = OrderCancelRequest G = OrderCancelReplaceRequest h = TradingSessionStatus UCC = Trade Cancel/Correct

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender: Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (TargetCompID for messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of sender: Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (TargetSubID for messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination: ‘CXJA’ for messages sent to the Alpha/Match marketplace. ‘CXJS’ for messages sent to the Select marketplace. (SenderCompID for messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination: ‘TEST’ for messages sent to Cboe test/certification system. ‘PROD’ for messages sent to Cboe production system. (SenderSubID for messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: N = (Default) Y = Indicates a message resend and should be used during FIX Replay. Cboe will reject all inbound orders with ‘Y’.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: UTC date-time that message was sent.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag=‘Y’, indicates time that message was first sent.
Check Sum Check Sum Modulo 256 Check Sum of all characters in message up to and

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average price of executions for this order weighted by trade size. Zero if Cum Qty is zero.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the order being accepted, executed or rejected. -or- Cl Ord ID of the cancel or replace request. -or- Cl Ord ID of the order subject to unsolicited cancel (Orig Cl Ord ID will not be present).

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity of shares executed for this order.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Day-unique id of execution message.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 0 = New 2 = Correction. Used to provide confirmed trading price for VWAP trades. 3 = Status. Used to provide peg suspensions (150=9) and order restatements (150=D).

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Copied from order, otherwise default value.

Field.Name: LastCapacity
Field.Description: Present on Fill and Partial Fill messages. 1 = Agent 2 = Cross as agent 3 = Cross as principal 4 = Principal

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Order Id (supplied by Cboe).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of order. 0 = New 1 = Partially Filled 2 = Filled 4 = Canceled 5 = Replaced 6 = Pending Cancel 8 = Rejected 9 = Suspended B = Calculated E = Pending Replace For FIX Drop, only ‘1’ or ‘2’ will be sent and will always equal Exec Type (150). For Order by Order FIX Drop, all execution information will be sent.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: UTC date-time that transaction occurred.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: (Present only on CXJ Alpha Drop Ports, only for BIDS trades)

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: (Present only on CXJ Alpha Drop Ports, only for BIDS trades)

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Copied from order if Time In Force is GTD (6).

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason for this Execution Report: 0 = New (acknowledgement of new order) 1 = Partial Fill 2 = Fill 4 = Canceled 5 = Replaced 8 = Rejected 9 = Suspended D = Restated For Standard FIX Drop, only ‘1’ or ‘2’ will be sent and will always equal Ord Status (39). For Order by Order FIX Drop, all execution information will be sent. Refer to section 7.2.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity of shares still open for further execution. Will be zero if order is dead, otherwise will be Order Qty (38) – Cum Qty (14). Note: It is possible for Leaves Qty to be zero when Exec Type (150) = ‘5’, indicating the order is dead.

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: Present on a Match Trade Prevention (MTP) triggered cancel/restatement, on a reserve reload restatement, and on a Cancel/Replace acknowledgement that increases the size of a reserve order. Contra side Cboe Order Id of prevented match (MTP), or Cboe PITCH Order Id for displayed portion of reserve order after reload, or Cboe PITCH Order Id for the displayed portion of a reserve order after a Cancel/Replace increased the size of the reserve order.

Field.Name: CashMargin
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: RiskGroupID
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: NoTradeFeat
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: NoTradeKey
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: PreventedTradePx
Field.Description: Provided if cancel or cancel/replace is the result of Match Trade Prevention (MTP). Indicates the trade price attempted when MTP was triggered.

Field.Name: PreventedTradeQty
Field.Description: Provided if cancel or cancel/replace is the result of Match Trade Prevention (MTP). Indicates the trade quantity attempted when MTP was triggered.

Field.Name: PreventedTradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Provided if cancel or cancel/replace is the result of Match Trade Prevention (MTP). Indicates the liquidity of the order attempted when MTP was triggered. A = Added liquidity R = Removed liquidity

Field.Name: VWAPSessionID
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: OrderClassification
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: ToSTNetTOrderID
Field.Description: Order Acceptance Number in To STNe T for this fill. (Present only on CXJ Alpha Drop Ports, only for BIDS trades)

Field.Name: ToSTNeTExecutionID
Field.Description: Execution Notice number in To STNe T for this fill. (Present only on CXJ Alpha Drop Ports, only for BIDS trades)

Field.Name: Pullback
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: ToSTNeTTransactTime
Field.Description: Transaction time in To STNe T (expressed as GMT) for this fill. (Present only on CXJ Alpha Drop Ports, only for BIDS trades)

Field.Name: MarginTransactionType
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: RoutingInst
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: ModifySequence
Field.Description: FIX Drop only. Base 36 number of times order has been replaced.

Field.Name: OrigCompID
Field.Description: FIX Drop and ODROP only. Target Comp ID of original FIX exec report.

Field.Name: OrigSubID
Field.Description: FIX Drop and ODROP only. Target Sub ID of original FIX exec report.

Field.Name: WorkingPrice
Field.Description: The price at which the order is effective on the book. Only present on Accepted, Replaced, or Restated and only when order is fully or partially booked.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Present for acknowledgements and fills (150=0, 150=1 or 150=2). Recommended mapping to FIX Tag 851 provided: A = Trade Added Liquidity (851=1) R = Trade Removed Liquidity (851=2) Match Trade Prevention (MTP) For participants that opt-in to Report MTP Fields functionality (at firm or port level), the liquidity add and remove values may be presented on an MTP triggered cancel/restatement. IMPORTANT: Trade Liquidity Indicator was Tag 9882 in the Chi-X Japan FIX specification. All Cboe markets use Tag 9730 for Trade Liquidity Indicator and Tag 9882 for Fee Code.

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with execution. See the Fee Schedule for the respective market for possible values. IMPORTANT: Trade Liquidity Indicator was Tag 9882 in the Chi-X Japan FIX specification. All Cboe markets use Tag 9730 for Trade Liquidity Indicator and Tag 9882 for Fee Code.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded on this fill (zero for non- fills).

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill (zero for non-fills). For VWAP Order Execution, this is the indicative price. For VWAP Price Restatement, this is the final VWAP trade price.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Present on Fill and Partial Fill messages. Supported MIC code values are as follows: CHIJ = (Alpha – continuous book) CHIS = (Select) CHIV = (Match - VWAP) KAIX = (BIDS trade – drop only)

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: The Broker ID (3-digit identifier) of the contra party on this fill. This tag is present if (and only if)Ord Statusis 2 (filled). Note: this is a standalone tag and is not used in conjunction with the No Contra Brokers(Tag 382) repeating group.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades on attributed orders. Always 1 if present.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded on this fill (zero for non- fills).

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill (zero for non-fills). For VWAP Order Execution, this is the indicative price. For VWAP Price Restatement, this is the final VWAP trade price.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Present on Fill and Partial Fill messages. Supported MIC code values are as follows: CHIJ = (Alpha – continuous book) CHIS = (Select) CHIV = (Match - VWAP) KAIX = (BIDS trade – drop only)

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: The Broker ID (3-digit identifier) of the contra party on this fill. This tag is present if (and only if)Ord Statusis 2 (filled). Note: this is a standalone tag and is not used in conjunction with the No Contra Brokers(Tag 382) repeating group.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades on attributed orders. Always 1 if present.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the order being cancelled or replaced (for a solicited , or Order Cancel , otherwise not present). Cancel/Replace

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates reason for reject or cancel. Format is one letter reason code followed by colon and space followed by free form text message. (e.g., ‘N: No Liquidity at price’). The specific text the system delivers may vary from the text listed below, to provide clarification of the reject reason. Reason codes are one of the following: A = Admin C = Capacity undefined D = Duplicate identifier (e.g., Cl Ord ID) F = Failed to Quote H = Halted J = Too late to cancel K = Order rate threshold exceeded L = Order would lock or cross PBBO M = Order size exceeded N = Ran out of liquidity to execute against O = Cl Ord ID doesn’t match a known order S = Short sale price violation T = Fill would trade through the NBBO U = User requested V = Would wash X = Order expired W = Add liquidity only order would remove Y = Symbol not supported Z = Unforeseen reason o = Max open orders count exceeded r = Reserve reload x = Crossed market y = Order received by Cboe during replay

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Refers to the Exec ID of the message being cancelled or corrected.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the order being cancelled or replaced (for a solicited , or Order Cancel , otherwise not present). Cancel/Replace

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Only used when Exec Type is Rejected (8). 0 = Exchange option 1 = Unknown symbol 2 = Exchange closed 3 = Order exceeds limit 5 = Unknown order 6 = Duplicate order 8 = Stale order

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates reason for reject or cancel. Format is one letter reason code followed by colon and space followed by free form text message. (e.g., ‘N: No Liquidity at price’). The specific text the system delivers may vary from the text listed below, to provide clarification of the reject reason. Reason codes are one of the following: A = Admin C = Capacity undefined D = Duplicate identifier (e.g., Cl Ord ID) F = Failed to Quote H = Halted J = Too late to cancel K = Order rate threshold exceeded L = Order would lock or cross PBBO M = Order size exceeded N = Ran out of liquidity to execute against O = Cl Ord ID doesn’t match a known order S = Short sale price violation T = Fill would trade through the NBBO U = User requested V = Would wash X = Order expired W = Add liquidity only order would remove Y = Symbol not supported Z = Unforeseen reason o = Max open orders count exceeded r = Reserve reload x = Crossed market y = Order received by Cboe during replay

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Only present when 150=D. 4 = Iceberg display size refreshed 5 = Partial Reduce due self-match trade prevention result based on No Trade Feat (7713) C = Confirmed price for VWAP trade
